summary_1line: Yudhishthira reluctantly accepts the dice challenge, travels to Hastinapura with the Pandavas, and enters the royal assembly where Sakuni urges the gambling to begin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira in royal robes rides a splendid chariot with his brothers and Draupadi as their procession departs for Hastinapura under a sense of ominous fate.
The Pandavas enter the grand Kuru assembly hall filled with kings while Sakuni rises with dice in hand to invite Yudhishthira to play.
Draupadi stands radiant among the women of the palace as Dhritarashtra’s daughters-in-law watch her with quiet jealousy.
